description: Fix hints attached to workflow tool validation errors. A rule matches when every provided field equals the issue (keyword, params) or its regex matches the issue path/message. First matching rule wins, so order specific rules before generic ones.

rules.hint: "version" must be the integer 2.
Every workflow document needs "version": 2, a "start" node id, and a non-empty "nodes" object.
"nodes" must contain at least one node; generate every node the flow walks through, ending in a result node.
"start" must be a node id matching ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ and reference an existing key of "nodes".
Node ids (keys of "nodes") must match ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$; all references must use these exact ids.
Transition targets ("to", "next", "onSuccess", "onFailure", "skipTo") must be existing node ids matching ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$. Do not use "${...}" expressions here.
Input and selection nodes must declare a dot-separated context "binding" such as "request.customerId"; add a matching field to "contextSchema".
Input nodes require a "component" from: text, multiline_text, number, date, datetime, otp, card, document, biometric.
"component" must be one of: text, multiline_text, number, date, datetime, otp, card, document, biometric.
Selection nodes require "options": either {"static": [{"value": ..., "label": {...}}]} or a provider-backed options source.
"options" must be either static ({"static": [...]}) or provider-based ({"provider": {...}}); do not mix both shapes.
Display nodes require "content" with either localized "markdown" or an "htmlProvider" string.
Display "content" needs exactly one of localized "markdown" or "htmlProvider" (+optional "providerRequest").
Confirmation nodes require a localized "summary" object, e.g. {"en": "...", "bn": "..."}.
Action and submit nodes need an "operation" string naming a backend operation.
Submit nodes require both "onSuccess" and "onFailure" node ids pointing at existing nodes.
Submit nodes require both "onSuccess" and "onFailure" node ids pointing at existing nodes.
Result nodes require "variant"; every workflow should end in at least one result node.
"variant" must be one of: success, error, unavailable, cancelled.
Each transition needs either "when": "${expression}" or "default": true (exactly one). Put conditional transitions first and end with one default.
Every transition needs a "to" node id that exists in "nodes".
Unsupported node "type". Supported types: input, selection, display, action, confirmation, submit, result.
Node "type" must be one of: input, selection, display, action, confirmation, submit, result.
Bindings are dot-separated context paths like "request.address.postcode"; each segment matches ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$. Register the root segment in "contextSchema".
"contextSchema" keys are binding paths like "request.customerId" (dot-separated identifiers matching ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*$).
Expressions are strings wrapped as "${...}" (minimum length 4), e.g. "${true}".
Expressions must be wrapped as "${...}", e.g. "${context.amount > 0}"; they cannot execute arbitrary code. Never use them for node references.
Date fields accept ISO "YYYY-MM-DD" strings or "${...}" expressions resolving to a date.
Localized text objects need at least one language key: "en" and/or "bn".
Localized text supports only the language keys "en" and "bn".
Nodes have no "id" property; the key inside "nodes" is the identifier - remove the redundant "id" field.
Unknown property for this object - remove it or check docs/kiosk-workflow.schema.json for allowed properties.
"start" points at a node id missing from "nodes"; set it to an existing node key.
The node's "group" must be a key of the top-level "groups" object; define the group there or drop the property.
A transition/target points at a node id absent from "nodes"; fix it to reference an existing node id (ids are case-sensitive).
Add a result node (type: "result", variant: success/error/unavailable/cancelled) reachable from start so the flow can terminate.
This object is missing a required property - see the kiosk-workflow.schema.json definition for this node type.

"contextSchema" must be a JSON object, not a string containing JSON - remove the surrounding quotes and use {} as an actual object. It is optional; omit it entirely unless explicit context field declarations are useful.
Wrong JSON type for this field - check the schema's declared "type" (string vs integer vs boolean vs object vs array).
